scripts.setup: npm install && cd server && npm install express cors dotenv prisma @prisma/client && npx prisma generate && cd ../warm-path && npm install
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run start:server" "npm run start:client" "npm run db:ui"
scripts.audit:all: npm audit && cd server && npm audit && cd ../warm-path && npm audit
scripts.audit:fix:all: npm audit fix && cd server && npm audit fix && cd ../warm-path && npm audit fix
scripts.validate: npm run setup && npm run build:client
scripts.upgrade:all: npx npm-check-updates -u && cd server && npx npm-check-updates -u && cd ../warm-path && npx npm-check-updates -u && cd .. && npm run refresh
scripts.refresh: npm run clean && rm -f package-lock.json server/package-lock.json warm-path/package-lock.json && npm run setup
